correctness.rationale: Every vertex misses one of n colors in a candidate n-coloring; all but two distance codes are determined by that missing color, ruling it out. For n+1 colors a modular Latin rectangle is proper, and the complete missing-pair distinctness proof handles all n>=9, including an explicit congruence-three correction, with finite n=6..8 checked exactly. The four linear-congruence obstructions and eight nonzero exceptional residues are reconstructed in RESULT.md, with independent finite shortest-path calculations in verify.py.
